correctness.rationale: Direct product-rule calculation proves odd-characteristic vanishing. In characteristic two, cubic relations imply all derivations have linear/quadratic generator images; the idempotence equations are necessary and sufficient. Splitting V into image/kernel of the linear projection classifies allowable quadratic images, and automorphism quadratic shears remove them. Every step including r=0,n is explicit. The image is U plus UW, proving rank. Gaussian-binomial counts of projection complements and independent quadratic coefficients prove all multiplicities. Standalone checker exhaustively agrees for (n,q)=(1,2),(1,3),(1,5),(2,2),(2,3), plus one-generator GF4 and constructed higher-rank shears. These tests are finite supports, not substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Idempotent derivations form a natural operator space and correspond to characteristic-two group gradings. For a standard finite local algebra family the result determines automorphism orbits and a complete finite-field rank invariant across all n, with a sharp characteristic boundary. The nontrivial quadratic-shear strata are not implied merely by the idempotent projection count or previously classified algebra retractions. Specific rank fibers and algebraic automorphism normal forms are reusable invariants.
